lines.t: Your love is brighter than the morning sun
Stronger than the oceans as they run
higher than the mountains reaching high faithful as the endless sky every heart and every limb
is held within your loving hand no height no depth no distant place could ever keep me from
Your grace, your love is never ending
Like a fountain forever flowing
Spilling over the top, that's never gonna stop
I, I, I find peace
In your love that will never cease
Pure and undefiled, the greatest of all
Your love
Every star that lights the sky above
Whispers of your endless love
Through every age your truth remains forever
Constant, never changed
Every breath and every day
Your perfect love will lead the way
No mountain high, no valley low
Could stop the love you always show
Your love is never ending
Like a fountain forever flowing
Spilling over the top
That's never gonna stop
I find peace
In your love that will never cease
Pure and undefiled
The greatest of all loves, your love
Deeper and wider than space and time
Your love is endless, pure, divine
Forever strong, forever true
Every road leads back to you
Your love is never ending, like a fount forever flowing
Spilling over the top, that's never gonna stop
I find peace in your love that will never cease
Pure and undefiled, the greatest of all
Your love, your love
Your love
Your love
